lessons_used: adoption/redesign changes are helpful, with 2 winning tests agreeing on positive impact (+8.7% average after noise correction).
sign_in/hint changes are helpful, with 2 winning tests agreeing on positive impact (+4.2% average after noise correction).
choose_path/copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home/new_screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path/layout, finish/new_flow, finish/notification, and sign_in/reorder as each has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high in Round 1, but significantly underestimated major winners in sign_in/hint (+11.5% vs +3.0% predicted) and adoption/redesign (+22.4% vs +3.3% predicted).

candidates.title: Live Interactive Companion Stage Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a dynamic stage carousel with instant live preview animations and trait callouts.
candidates.why: Adoption step takes median 89s / mean 1017s with an 80.2% conversion. Lessons show adoption redesigns had strong positive impact (+8.7% average).

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Explore companion breeds and choose who lives on your screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns the friend selection screen while retaining its required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Strong historical pattern of positive results (+8.7%) for adoption redesigns addressing high time spent.

candidates.title: Pet Safe Persistence Sign-In Reassurance Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explicit account persistence hint to the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in syncs and saves their pet securely.
candidates.why: Support mail highlighted 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in, and lessons show sign_in hint changes have a +4.2% average win rate.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your pet collection across devices and prevents pet resets.

guard.reason: Adds a valid sign-in persistence hint to the sign-in screen without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Directly backed by support tickets and a proven winning pattern (+4.2%) at minimal implementation cost.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Desktop Launch Guidance Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated desktop launch screen right after home introduction to guide users on finding and bringing their pet onto their screen.
candidates.why: Finish step drops to 64.8% (lowest conversion) with high drop-off and support tickets regarding missing desktop pets or control confusion.

new_desktop_launch.headline: Your Companion is Ready for Desktop!
new_desktop_launch.body: Look for your companion wandering near your taskbar. Double click to interact anytime.

guard.reason: Adds a new post-onboarding guidance screen following home_intro, which is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the lowest-converting step and support complaints, but new screens carry historical friction.

candidates.title: Real-Time Pet Hatching Status and Tip Tracker
candidates.change: Enhances the waiting screen with a animated initialization status tracker, visual progress bar, and rotating desktop care tips.
candidates.why: The waiting stage (home) takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating severe drop-offs before completion.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home...
waiting.body: We are setting up your companion's animations and favorite spots.

components.text: Tip: You can move your pet anywhere on your desktop by dragging it.

guard.reason: Enhances the waiting screen with status and tip tracking, explicitly allowed in onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets extreme wait times on home step, though past home changes showed negligible impact.

candidates.title: Dual Path Visual Cards Selection Layout
candidates.change: Reconfigures the path selection screen into a split card layout highlighting 'Adopt Ready Pet' vs 'Create Custom Pet' with clear imagery.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users immediately (76.2% conversion) with high mean time (514s), indicating hesitation and lack of visual clarity.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Start?
choose_path.body: Pick a quick ready-to-play pet or craft a custom companion from your photos.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Deferred Sign-In After Adoption Certificate Flow
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after completing the adoption certificate rather than before pet adoption.
candidates.why: Allows users to bond with their created pet and receive their certificate before committing to account creation, increasing sign-in motivation.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step to occur after adoption certificate, which is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in has previously shown negative results (-7.0%) in past testing.

candidates.title: Desktop Quick Control Orientation Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive post-onboarding orientation flow demonstrating how to hide, feed, and summon the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support mail contained multiple confusion tickets on 'Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet' after setup.

new_control_basics.headline: Quick Desktop Controls
new_control_basics.body: Right-click your pet anytime to access feeding, games, or to hide them safely in the tray.

guard.reason: Adds an interactive orientation screen after home_intro within onboarding scope.

candidates.score_note: Strong funnel drop-off and support mail evidence, but prior new flow test hurt conversion (-6.9%).

candidates.title: First Desktop Treat Reward Incentive Prompt
candidates.change: Offers a bonus starter treat pack on the waiting screen to reward users for completing pet setup.
candidates.why: Increases excitement during the long initialization waiting period (201s median) and encourages final completion.

components.text: Bonus Unlocked: Starter Snack Pack Included!

guard.reason: Mentions a bonus/starter snack pack gift in onboarding copy, violating rule 3.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Personalization Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen with interactive name customization and official seal badge stamp.
candidates.why: Adoption flow speed and emotional attachment are critical drivers to push users past the home initialization step.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new companion a name to make it officially yours!

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[0]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Finish Step Onboarding Victory Celebration Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns home_intro into a vibrant celebration stage screen with sound effect prompt and clear welcome badge.
candidates.why: The final step has the worst conversion (64.8%), where users drop off just before seeing their desktop pet active.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Home to Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a sound cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

lessons_next: adoption/redesign changes are helpful, with 3 winning tests agreeing on positive impact (+7.1% average after noise correction).
sign_in/hint changes are helpful, with 2 winning tests agreeing on positive impact, though 2 later tests showed no clear effect (+2.9% average after noise correction).
choose_path/copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home/new_screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path/layout, finish/new_flow, finish/new_screen, finish/notification, home/wait_info, and sign_in/reorder as each has only one test.
Predictions were overstated in Round 1 and for weak ideas, but significantly underestimated major winners in adoption/redesign and sign_in/hint.
